map.📖 查看「/ L / E / M 使用指南」: 📖 View the "T / L / E / M User Guide"
map.Δ 为路线转角（圆心角）。: Δ is the route deflection (central angle).
map.由半径与转角算切线/曲线长/外距/中点弦。: From radius and deflection angle compute tangent / curve length / external / middle ordinate.
map.R=200m、Δ=60°：切线 T=R·tan(Δ/2)=200×tan30°≈: R=200 m, Δ=60°: tangent T = R·tan(Δ/2) = 200×tan30° ≈ 115.5 m; curve length L = R·Δ(rad) = 200×π/3 ≈ 209.4 m; external E = R(sec30°−1) ≈ 30.9 m; middle ordinate M = R(1−cos30°) ≈ 26.8 m.
map.ZY=JD−T、YZ=ZY+L，按 T/L/E/M 布桩，圆曲线完整标定。: ZY = JD − T, YZ = ZY + L; set stakes by T/L/E/M to fully mark the circular curve.
map.切线长干嘛用？: What is the tangent length for?
map.从交点 JD 沿两切线量 T 得直圆点 ZY/圆直点 YZ，是放样起点。: Measuring T along the two tangents from the intersection JD gives the tangent-to-curve point ZY / curve-to-tangent point YZ, the start of staking.
map.外距 E 意义？: What is the meaning of external E?
map.交点到曲线中点（垂距），用于校核与设置曲线中点桩。: The perpendicular distance from the intersection to the curve midpoint, used for checking and setting the curve-midpoint stake.
